prayerExcerpt.en-US: From his infancy he was exceedingly given to prayer and meditation, and his life was remarkably innocent and holy.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Desde a infância dava-se extremamente à oração e à meditação, e sua vida era notavelmente inocente e santa.

meta.face: A Burgundian noble of about sixty, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a fair, lightly ruddy complexion and a SQUARE-OVAL face, full-cheeked, marked by a LONG, STRAIGHT, prominent nose that runs from a HIGH ROOT between the brows with almost no dip, like a Greek statue's; a broad, smooth forehead under the tonsure; calm, heavy-lidded grey-blue eyes set level under light, straight brows; smooth, FULL cheeks; a small, firm, closed mouth; a DEEP, rounded chin; greying fair-brown hair in a broad monastic crown; the gaze serene and noble, a little above us.
meta.basis: No likeness from life; Wikipedia's lead image is the twelfth-century miniature of Hugh with Henry IV and Matilda of Tuscany at Canossa. The book tells a prince of the house of Burgundy, professed at Cluny at sixteen under St. Odilo, abbot at twenty-five for sixty-two years, dying in 1109; its engraving shows monks in a cloister. Wikipedia and its Cluny Abbey say Hugh built the third abbey church, begun in 1089, the largest church in the world until St. Peter's. The full, square-oval face with the Greek line of the nose is our choice, apart from `hugh_grenoble`'s apple-round face and `aelred`'s soft long one.
